resources.string: Independent online artwork source. No Apple account required. When enabled, song, artist, album and lookup URLs are sent to Apple. Only matched, validated square videos are supplied. Disabled by default; downloads use unmetered networks by default. Ambiguous matches and source changes keep the original cover.
Catalog market (two letters, e.g. us or cn)
Saved. Re-enable the Bridge integration test to apply market or network changes.
Authorize the current Bridge signature for preview
Current Bridge authorized. Platform-signed SystemUI is checked independently by UID.
Disable source and revoke preview access
Source disabled. Also disable the Bridge test to remove any currently playing video.
Unused cache cleared; leased videos remain until released
